Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. blocks.text: River Springs home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

5 houses sold in River Springs with a median price of $1,205,000, taking a median of 17 days to sell at 98.5% of the last list price; 20% sold above list. They had a median $565 per square foot, a median year built of 1981 and a median lot of 4,506 square feet.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in River Springs?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 4 houses listed in River Springs. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is River Springs a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 25% on only 4 listed, too few to read as a market type. The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in River Springs from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 5 houses and 0 condos and townhomes sold in River Springs over those 5 months; detached houses peaked in June with 2 sold.

faq.q: How big is River Springs compared with the rest of Coquitlam?
faq.a: In October 2026, River Springs held 1.1% of the 378 detached houses listed in Coquitlam.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in River Springs than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 6 in June to 4 in October 2026 (−33.3%).

faq.q: What did houses in River Springs sell for?
faq.a: 5 houses sold in River Springs between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,205,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in River Springs?
faq.a: The median was 17 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.5% of the last list price (20% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
